    3. What is this dish

    What is this dish

    The Thai dishes you will meet at the canteen, explained for someone who has never had them.

    • Curry over rice

      ข้าวราดแกง

      A plate of rice with one or two curries or dishes of your choice from the pots at the counter.

      30 to 50 baht at 1 stall

    • Fried rice

      ข้าวผัด

      Rice stir-fried with egg and your choice of meat, seasoned with soy and oyster sauce, served with cucumber, a lime wedge and chilli in fish...

      35 to 85 baht at 4 stalls

    • Khao man gai, Hainanese chicken rice

      ข้าวมันไก่

      Poached or fried chicken over rice cooked in chicken fat, with a salty-sweet fermented bean dipping sauce and a clear broth.

      45 to 65 baht at 2 stalls

    • Khao mok gai, Thai-style chicken biryani

      ข้าวหมกไก่

      Rice cooked with spices and turmeric, topped with fried or poached chicken, eaten with a sour dipping sauce and a small bowl of broth.

      50 to 60 baht at 1 stall

    • Larb, minced meat salad

      ลาบ

      Minced meat dressed with lime juice, fish sauce, chilli flakes and toasted rice powder, topped with mint and spring onion.

      40 to 50 baht at 2 stalls

    • Pad kra pao, holy basil stir-fry over rice

      ข้าวกะเพรา

      Minced meat stir-fried with holy basil, chilli and garlic, served over rice and usually topped with a crispy fried egg.

      40 to 65 baht at 3 stalls

    • Pad see ew, stir-fried wide noodles in soy sauce

      ผัดซีอิ๊ว

      Wide rice noodles fried with dark soy sauce, egg and Chinese broccoli.

      40 baht at 1 stall

    • Pad Thai

      ผัดไทย

      Rice noodles fried in a tamarind sauce with egg, tofu and bean sprouts, topped with crushed peanuts and served with lime and garlic chives.

      40 to 45 baht at 1 stall

    • Rad na, noodles in thick gravy

      ราดหน้า

      Pan-fried wide noodles or crispy noodles under a thick, glossy gravy with Chinese broccoli and meat.

      40 baht at 2 stalls

    • Rice balls in coconut milk

      บัวลอย

      Chewy glutinous rice balls in warm, lightly salted sweet coconut milk, with an optional sweet egg.

      25 to 30 baht at 1 stall

    • Rice noodle soup

      ก๋วยเตี๋ยว

      Rice noodles in hot broth.

      40 to 60 baht at 2 stalls

    • Rice porridge

      โจ๊ก

      Hot, smooth rice porridge with ginger, spring onion and a soft egg.

      No stall sells this in our survey yet.

    • Som tam, green papaya salad

      ส้มตำ

      Shredded unripe papaya pounded with chilli, garlic, lime, fish sauce and palm sugar.

      35 to 50 baht at 1 stall

    • Thai iced tea

      ชาเย็น

      Strong Assam tea sweetened with condensed milk and finished with milk, served over ice.

      13 to 60 baht at 4 stalls

    • Thai omelette

      ไข่เจียว

      Beaten eggs fried in plenty of hot oil until puffed and crispy at the edges, eaten over rice with chilli sauce.

      30 to 60 baht at 2 stalls

    • Tom yum, hot and sour soup

      ต้มยำ

      A hot and sour soup scented with lemongrass, galangal and makrut lime leaf, clear or creamy.

      50 baht at 1 stall
